extraction_notes: Only SI performance figures visible in the supplied page images were digitised: SI Figure S1 and SI Figure S4. SI Figure S1 reports MeOH yield versus contact time, which is not a standard field in the requested schema; to avoid mislabelling it as STY, those values are provided as an extra per-record field named methanol_yield below. SI Figure S2 is reaction-order analysis and SI Figure S3 is a deactivation-fitting plot, so they were not digitised as conversion/selectivity/STY performance records. Printed SI tables were not re-entered.
